'''Falador Teleport''' is a [[Magic]] spell that teleports the caster to [[Falador]].

Like most teleports, this spell cannot be used past level 20 [[Wilderness]].

Casting this spell is a requirement for the [[Medium Falador|medium Falador diary]].
